title: Overhead Water Tank Overflow Alarm
problem: The water pump on our hostel building runs continuously, making the roof tanks overflow for hours and wasting drinking water.
idea: A camera watches a floating marker in the tank. When the water reaches the top mark, a loud alarm tells the watchman to switch off the motor. Try the alarm and see how much water we save.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: Where is the floating marker?
widgets.intro: In my real project, PictoBlox watches a bright coloured float through a camera. Tap where the float is now.
widgets.question: The camera sees the float at:

options.label: Bottom mark
options.result: Tank is almost empty. Switch ON the motor.
options.te: ట్యాంక్ దాదాపు ఖాళీ. మోటర్ ఆన్ చేయండి.

options.label: Middle mark
options.result: Tank is half full. Motor can keep running.

options.label: Top mark
options.result: ALARM! Tank is full. Switch OFF the motor now!
options.te: అలారం! ట్యాంక్ నిండిపోయింది. వెంటనే మోటర్ ఆపండి!
options.tip: The alarm keeps ringing until someone switches off the motor.

widgets.heading: 🧮 How much water is wasted by overflow?
widgets.intro: Check how long the tank overflows each day. Use a bucket and a watch to find how many litres the pipe gives in one minute.

inputs.label: Water flow from pipe (litres per minute)
Minutes the tank overflows each day

widgets.formula: if (typeof lpm !== 'number' || typeof mins !== 'number' || typeof days !== 'number') return null; if (lpm <= 0 || mins < 0 || days <= 0) return null; var day = lpm * mins; var month = day * days; var buckets = Math.round(month / 15); var level = mins === 0 ? 'good' : (mins <= 15 ? 'warn' : 'bad'); return {day: day, month: month, buckets: buckets, level: level};
widgets.result:
Wasted per day: {day} litres
Wasted per month: {month} litres
That is about {buckets} buckets of water (15 L each)!

widgets.heading: 💧 Water Saving Tips for the Hostel

items.title: Note the fill time
items.text: Find how many minutes the tank takes to fill and set a timer.
items.te: ట్యాంక్ నిండడానికి ఎంత సమయం పడుతుందో చూసి టైమర్ పెట్టండి.

items.title: Ask for an auto switch
items.text: Ask the school to fit a cheap automatic water level controller.
items.te: ఆటోమేటిక్ వాటర్ లెవెల్ కంట్రోలర్ పెట్టమని అడగండి.

items.title: Close taps
items.text: Close dripping taps. A dripping tap wastes many litres in a day.

how: Make a float: tie a bright red plastic ball to a thin stick so it rises with the water.
Mark Bottom, Middle and Top lines on the tank wall (or on a clear test bottle at first).
In PictoBlox, add the camera / Computer Vision extension and detect the red colour position.
Use 'if y position > top mark' to play a loud alarm sound and show 'Switch OFF motor'.
Test with a bottle of water at your desk before trying on the real tank (always with a teacher, never alone on the roof).
Ask Gemini to write the alarm message in Telugu and English.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Write a short, loud alarm message in Telugu and English that tells our hostel watchman to switch off the water motor because the tank is full. Also give 3 simple tips to stop tank overflow.
